description: This Java class 'ContractService' is a service layer component in a Spring application responsible for handling business logic related to 'Contract' entities. It manages printing contracts as PDF, processing hierarchy-based acceptance routing, and basic CRUD operations via repository interactions.

classes.name: ContractService
classes.description: A Spring service component providing operations for managing Contract entities, including printing, hierarchy-based acceptance, and repository interactions.

methods.name: print
methods.description: Uses PdfService to print given Contract in PDF format.

methods.name: sendToSupervisor
methods.description: Recursively searches up the supervisor chain to find a supervisor authorized to accept the contract based on its value, and assigns acceptance accordingly.

methods.name: acceptContract
methods.description: Accepts the contract if the currently authenticated user is the designated accepter.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Retrieves a Contract by its unique ID.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the specified Contract entity to the repository.

methods.name: findByClient
methods.description: Returns a list of contracts associated with a specific client.

methods.name: findByAcceptedBy
methods.description: Returns a list of contracts accepted by a specific user.
